## Summary

Describe the change and how it was verified.

## Privacy checklist

- [ ] `pnpm privacy:check` passes.
- [ ] No database, raw snapshot, generated corpus, download, log, report, archive, browser state, `.env` file, token, credential, or personal absolute path is included.
- [ ] Fixtures contain synthetic data only.
- [ ] The server remains bound to localhost and no unauthenticated endpoint was exposed beyond that boundary.
